tokens.styling: termbox attributes (color + bold/underline) via Ratatouille.Constants; a restrained accent + neutral cells
tokens.layout: row/column/panel composition; size from the window dimensions on each render

components.name: prompt / select
components.when_to_use: interactive prompts + multiselect in mix tasks/CLIs

components.name: progress / live output
components.when_to_use: progress bars and live-updating output outside a full-screen app

rules: Use the Elm Architecture: model/update/view/subscribe; view/2 is pure, all state changes flow through update/2 on messages.
Drive a control-surface TUI from the SAME BEAM node: turn PubSub/GenServer messages into TEA subscriptions.
Use Owl for prompt/output UX (colored tags, select, tables, progress); use Ratatouille for a full-screen interactive app — they compose.

Ratatouille is capped by termbox's feature set and is mature-but-quiet; if you need richer widgets, the pragmatic escape hatch is a Go (Bubble Tea) or Rust (Ratatui) sidecar over a port — but that adds a non-BEAM binary.
